limitations: Purpose-scoped semantic judgments (active_contract_judgment, acquisition_clause_judgment, obligation_kind_judgment) are not materialized in 06_world/world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py loads them from 05_dispositions.json as required external premises.

Two identity_judgment candidate pairs noted in 06_admission.json (billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH/registry:HRB 88421 and billing:Vellum Print Co Ltd/contract:SOW-VEL-2022) were never adjudicated and therefore do not participate in derivations.
active_contract_judgment dispositions in 05_dispositions.json use ACCEPT/REJECT; derivations map ACCEPT→ACTIVE and REJECT→INACTIVE per vocabulary epistemic_contract.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter on world-grounded invoice status; no unresolved disposition.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is invoice_record; every invoice with status=open is included.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Row inclusion uses identity_judgment or mechanical legal_name_variant to link billing billed_name to contract; association field maps identity_judgment SAME_ENTITY→asserted and any other/missing billing↔contract judgment→unresolved. UNRESOLVED association does not exclude the invoice row.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every represented billed invoice linked (asserted or unresolved) to an ACTIVE contract with at least one ACCEPT acquisition_clause_judgment kind listed in contracts/purpose_a.json is emitted; sorted by invoice_id.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Cross invoice_record with contract_record where active_contract_judgment=ACTIVE (ACCEPT), acquisition_clause_judgment has ACCEPT on an allowed kind, and billing↔contract link holds via identity_judgment tuple or legal_name_variant(billed_name, counterparty_name); render per contracts/purpose_a.json.
required_premise: active_contract_judgment disposition for each candidate contract (from 05_dispositions.json)
acquisition_clause_judgment ACCEPT on at least one allowed kind per qualifying contract (from 05_dispositions.json)
identity_judgment disposition for billing↔contract pairs when present (from world.sqlite groundings / 05_dispositions.json)
optional_enrichment: legal_name_variant enables invoice↔contract candidate linkage when no identity_judgment billing↔contract tuple exists
typed_identifier and invoice_tax_identifier may support connectivity but are not required for row emission
blocking_unresolved_state: active_contract_judgment UNRESOLVED blocks contract from qualifying
no ACCEPT acquisition_clause_judgment on any allowed kind blocks contract from qualifying
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing↔contract still qualifies the invoice row with association=unresolved
acquisition_clause_judgment UNRESOLVED on individual kinds does not block when another allowed kind is ACCEPT

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Epistemic field copies identity_judgment disposition (SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED) with contracts/purpose_b.json mapping; pairs emitted in class_rank orientation (crm < billing < contract < registry).
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit every identity_judgment tuple admitted to world.sqlite that satisfies Purpose B connectivity (required CRM–billing–contract–registry links for commercially relevant relationships); sorted by left then right.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Read identity_judgment from world.sqlite; orient (left,right) by class_rank; map disposition to epistemic output field.
required_premise: identity_judgment dispositions recorded in assertion grounding detail (from 05_dispositions.json via P6 admission)
optional_enrichment: legal_name_variant informed candidate generation upstream but does not substitute for emitted identity_judgment links
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED is a first-class output epistemic value; silence on a pair is not DISTINCT

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Contract-centric row when ACTIVE and at least one ACCEPT obligation_kind_judgment; status=dependent only when current-relationship leg and qualifying-obligation leg hold and billing↔contract identity_judgment is SAME_ENTITY; otherwise status=unresolved when blocked solely by identity uncertainty.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One row per ACTIVE contract with at least one ACCEPT obligation kind in contracts/purpose_c.json allowed set; sorted by contract_id with obligation_kinds sorted ascending.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each qualifying contract, collect ACCEPT obligation kinds, open_invoice_ids linked via identity_judgment or legal_name_variant, evaluate current-relationship (open invoice OR auto_renewal/rolling_term ACCEPT), set status from billing↔contract identity disposition; counterparty uses billing: identifier when linkable.
required_premise: obligation_kind_judgment ACCEPT dispositions for allowed kinds (from 05_dispositions.json)
open_invoice and invoice_record for current-relationship leg
identity_judgment disposition for billing↔contract join when asserting dependent
optional_enrichment: legal_name_variant supports invoice↔contract linkage and counterparty billing identifier selection
typed_identifier provides canonical counterparty string forms
blocking_unresolved_state: active_contract_judgment REJECT/INACTIVE excludes the contract row
no ACCEPT obligation_kind_judgment excludes the contract row
identity_judgment UNRESOLVED on billing↔contract blocks status=dependent
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED still emits a dependency row with status=unresolved when obligation and activity premises are met
obligation_kind_judgment UNRESOLVED on one kind does not block when another allowed kind is ACCEPT
open_invoice_ids may be empty when auto_renewal or rolling_term satisfies the current-relationship leg
